notablePrerequisites:
Tamiyo's Compleation attached to Ugin's Nexus.
Artificer Class is level three.
description:
At the beginning of your end step, Artificer Class triggers, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Put the token Ugin's Nexus into exile due to the legend rule, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
